quests.title: Wangshu Take-Away

dialogue.sit: Sorry, I'm busy at the moment.

dialogue.t: Huh, still busy, are you? Well then, guess I need to look for someone else.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Tacit Tingfang

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: That fellow Tingfang ordered some Black-Back Perch Stew. He should have headed off to Qingce Village by now.

This Black-Back Perch Stew has had greater emphasis placed on the quality of its soup. So you can't fly or climb all over the place, or you'll spill it for sure. You'll want to make the delivery quick, too.
If you meet with an accident along the way, come back here and I'll make you another serving.

quests.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...
